summary: Open as Read-Only now works for Excel workbook links in the installed app, not only in development mode.
details: The installed app launched Excel from its packaged app.asar folder, which Windows rejects as a working directory and reported as "spawn powershell.exe ENOENT".
Host commands now run from a real directory and resolve PowerShell under %SystemRoot% instead of the inherited PATH.
Applies to read-only Excel opening from DFM Notes, Dataset links, and File Explorer, plus Open Terminal.
